scope.summary: Makes Explorer global object and source matches expose exact selected state, visible feedback, and details without retaining prior object output after a selection changes.

entry_points.trace: `cd web && npm exec playwright test e2e/ux-explorer-selection.spec.ts --config playwright.config.ts` exited 0 with one Chromium test. It selects an object match, renders its DDL, then selects one of two source-line matches and proves the exact aria-pressed state, in-context status, and cleared prior DDL.

limitations: This is local browser coverage with stubbed operator responses and does not claim a live Oracle search run.
